tools.description: Create a project, book 1, and chapter 1
tools.name: create_project

branch_id.description:
Id of the project's main bible branch. Each project gets its own main
branch (per-project main branch design, Phase 6); the SurrealDB era
had a singleton `bible_branch:main` shared globally — that assumption
is no longer valid. `#[serde(default)]` keeps older clients that
don't send this field on round-trips compatible.

tools.description: List all projects with their record ids
tools.name: list_projects

project_id.description: Record id to use with other tools (e.g. "project:abc123def")

tools.description: Persist the default project and branch for this MCP session so follow-up tool calls can omit project_id and use the current branch by default
tools.name: set_active_project

tools.description: Create the next book within a project
tools.name: create_book

tools.description: Create the next chapter within a book using book_number or book_id; optional chapter_number may be any unused non-negative number (gaps are allowed, e.g. for restructures) and defaults to one past the current maximum
tools.name: create_chapter

title.description:
The chapter's effective title after the call: the supplied title when
it was applied, otherwise the title the chapter already had (the
ensure path can return a pre-existing row). `None` when untitled.

tools.description: List configured model agents and their route assignments
tools.name: list_agents

tools.description: List the embedded Spindle workflow skills and craft references. Tool equivalent of browsing bible://skills/* and bible://references/*; use get_skill / get_reference to read one.
tools.name: list_skills

tools.description: Return the full content of an embedded Spindle skill. Tool equivalent of reading bible://skills/{name}; call this to load a workflow such as scene-writer or character-creator.
tools.name: get_skill

tools.description: Return the full content of an embedded craft reference. Tool equivalent of reading bible://references/{name}.

name.description: Reference name from list_skills, or contracts/tools/v1/<tool> for a full response schema.

tools.name: get_reference

tools.description: Return a branch-aware re-anchor packet with current cursor state, constraints, subjects, recent scenes, overlays, divergence warnings, and recent activity Full response schema: bible://contracts/tools/v1/get_writer_state (also available through get_reference).

at_scene_id.description:
Optional explicit scene cursor. When omitted, Spindle derives the cursor
from the most recent written scene on the branch.

branch_id.description: Optional explicit branch. Defaults to the active branch.

budget_tokens.description: Preferred token budget for markdown rendering metadata.

include_recent_activity.description: Include derived recent activity. Defaults to true.

include_subjects.description: Include derived subject snapshots. Defaults to true.

project_id.description: Record id returned by create_project (for example "project:abc123def")

recent_activity_limit.description: Maximum number of recent activity entries to include. Defaults to 20.

tools.name: get_writer_state

tools.description: Assemble standards, novel, and scene context using chapter_id or explicit book_number and chapter_number Full response schema: bible://contracts/tools/v1/get_scene_context (also available through get_reference).

budget_tokens.description:
Preferred token budget for temporary inline trimming. Mandatory hard
constraints may expand the effective budget rather than being dropped.

max_character_count.description:
Optional opt-in cap for resolved scene characters. When omitted, all
requested characters are included. If set, the first N character ids in
caller order are used for the scene-layer roster and character-dependent
briefings.

sections.description:
Optional section filter. When omitted, the full scene context is
returned. Supported top-level groups: "standards", "novel", "scene".
Supported novel sections: "reader_contract", "world_rules",
"system_overlays", "timeline_briefing", "future_knowledge_briefing",
"pacing_directives", "narrative_promises_due", "knowledge_briefing",
"semantic_references", "previous_scene_tail". Supported scene sections:
"location",
"world_state", "characters", "relationships", "agency_check".

token_budget.description: Legacy budget field retained for backwards compatibility.

tools.name: get_scene_context

tools.description: Resolve one entity by table and record id as a polymorphic subject snapshot Full response schema: bible://contracts/tools/v1/get_entity (also available through get_reference).

branch_id.description: Optional explicit branch. Defaults to the active branch.

entity_id.description: Record id for the requested entity (for example "character:abc123def")

project_id.description: Record id returned by create_project (for example "project:abc123def")

table.description: Subject table kind for the requested entity.

tools.name: get_entity

tools.description: Assemble a compact pre-write briefing with continuity sheets, recent summaries, chapter plans, and lean scene context Full response schema: bible://contracts/tools/v1/get_chapter_briefing (also available through get_reference).

budget_tokens.description: Preferred token budget for temporary inline trimming.

recent_chapter_limit.description: Number of prior chapter summaries to include, newest first. Defaults to 3.

token_budget.description:
Token budget passed through to the bundled scene-context slice.
Defaults to the service's chapter-briefing budget when omitted.

tools.name: get_chapter_briefing

tools.description: Create or update a scene draft using chapter_id or explicit book_number and chapter_number; accepts content as an alias for full_text

authorship.description:
Use assistant for prose composed or revised by the host AI. Human by
default. Enables opt-in learning from a later human edit, not AI edits.

book_number.description: Optional explicit book placement. When omitted, provide `chapter_id`.

chapter_id.description:
Optional chapter reference. When provided, Spindle resolves book/chapter
placement from the existing chapter instead of requiring numeric fields.

chapter_number.description: Optional explicit chapter placement. When omitted, provide `chapter_id`.

generation_id.description:
Optional server-side receipt id returned by `continue_generation`.
Required when saving explicit sexual prose with `content_rating:
"explicit"`. The receipt is provenance only: it proves the save was
authorized by a cleared, explicit-capable draft-route generation and
stamps `draft_origin: agent:<id>`. The caller-supplied `full_text` is
authoritative and is what Spindle persists — the receipt output is never
substituted for the prose.

knowledge_learned.description:
On-page knowledge acquisitions to record with this scene (design §2.3
path 2). Each entry becomes a knowledge_fact row stamped at this scene's
placement; a `secret_of_fact_id` link expands that secret's circle of
trust. Additive — an empty vector behaves exactly as before.

items.description:
One on-page knowledge acquisition flagged in a scene's continuity package
(design §2.3 path 2, the draft-time reveal). Each entry becomes a
`knowledge_fact` row for `character_id`, learned_at = the saving scene's
placement. When `secret_of_fact_id` names a secret canonical fact, the row
links to it and expands that secret's circle of trust from this scene
forward — the reveal mechanism. `None` there records ordinary knowledge.

character_id.description: The character who learns the fact (a create_character record id).

fact.description: The fact learned, as a short natural-language statement.

reader_visible.description:
Whether the reader is meant to know this (dramatic-irony control). When
omitted, defaults to visible.

secret_of_fact_id.description:
When set, links this knowledge to a secret canonical fact (its circle of
trust expands to include `character_id`). The id must reference an
existing canonical fact marked `secret = 1`, or the save is rejected.

source_summary.description: Optional note on how/where it was learned (rendered into the row).

location_id.description:
Optional location (record id returned by create_location) this scene is
set in. Persisted on the scene so the pre-draft temporal anchor can name
where the previous scene ended. Re-saving without it preserves the
existing value (it is never cleared by an omitted field).

source_path.description:
Optional path to the local source file this scene was written from.
When provided, Spindle tracks the file for divergence detection.

tools.name: save_scene_draft

oneOf.description: Reserved for Phase 4 validator expansion; intentionally unused in Phase 1.
Reserved for Phase 4 validator expansion; intentionally unused in Phase 1.

rewrite_hint.description: Short rewrite-from-beats direction (not a synonym swap).

hard_count.description: Hard shelves over their pack limit. Soft never increments this.

structural_observations.description:
StoryScope-inspired notes. Empty unless experimental structural is on.
Never increment `hard_count`.

oneOf.description:
A character references, in prose, a `knowledge_fact` they do not learn
until a later story position. High-precision/low-recall advisory.

ScanSurface.description: Surfaces the scanner is allowed to consider. Non-fiction is skipped.

question_id.description: Stable question id (not a shelf id).

anti_slop.description:
Fiction anti-slop scan of the saved prose. Soft and hard hits are
advisory on save — this field never fails the write. Hard over-limit
fail-closes only on the verify/revise path when that loop is on.

draft_origin.description: Origin recorded for the saved prose, e.g. `client` or `agent:venice`.

style_warnings.description:
Genre-voice mismatches against the project style contract (reader
contract style_notes, `style` world rules, narrator voice). A non-empty
list is a failed style gate — revise before committing. Coarse by
design; an empty list is not proof the scene is on-genre.

temporal_findings.description:
Intra-scene temporal-coherence advisories (deterministic prose scan):
unsignaled time-of-day teleports, internal time drift, and unrendered
declared spans. Advisory-only — every entry is `severity: "warning"` and
never blocks a save.

tools.description: Execute exactly one safe authoring action for the active run

mode.description:
Optional execution mode for drafting steps.

Default is "hybrid": the host assistant drafts non-explicit prose in
the active chat using Spindle context/tools, while explicit scenes may
still be routed through the configured explicit draft backend.

Set to "agent" only for fully automated test/offload runs.
